claims.claimText: Orca publishes two consumer tiers: Orca Plus at EUR 49/year and Orca Smart Navigation at EUR 149/year.
claims.limitations: Tax treatment and territory of the displayed EUR price are not stated on the help page.

claims.claimText: Orca's current hardware package is priced at EUR 1,997 including VAT as the sum of Display 2 (EUR 999), Core 2 (EUR 649) and charging mount (EUR 349).
claims.unit: EUR including VAT, complete hardware package
claims.limitations: Editorial quotation of configurator prices at test time; tax basis is the reviewer's, not a manufacturer invoice.

claims.claimText: Orca includes third-party autopilot control and AIS-over-internet in every tier, including the free tier, but local instrument/autopilot integration requires the Core device.
claims.observedValue: autopilot control included in every tier; Core required for NMEA 2000 integration
claims.limitations: Single editorial test; autopilot control is read/command over an existing third-party pilot, not a MAREA-type supervised steering product.

claims.claimText: Orca Core 'guard mode' provides a basic remote-monitoring substitute: location visibility and battery-voltage monitoring, with an anchor alarm included in Smart Navigation.
claims.observedValue: anchor alarm and basic monitoring require Core and Smart Navigation
claims.limitations: Requires powered/online devices; not a cellular monitoring service and no independent alert-reliability evidence.

claims.claimText: PredictWind lists three paid forecast tiers at USD 29/year (Basic), USD 249/year (Standard) and USD 499/year (Professional).
claims.limitations: USD list; auto-renewal; feature depth differs materially between tiers.

claims.claimText: PredictWind states that local taxes are added at checkout, so its published USD prices are tax-exclusive for most territories.
claims.limitations: Applies to forecast subscriptions; hardware pages do not restate the tax rule.

claims.claimText: PredictWind DataHub is listed at USD 299 and DataHub Pro at USD 599; GPS tracking requires no subscription, an optional LTE data plan costs USD 10/month, and Over-the-Horizon AIS/AI Polars require a Professional forecast subscription.
claims.limitations: USD list prices without cart tax display; satellite devices and airtime are separate.

claims.claimText: Digital Yacht's Spanish shop lists NavLink2 at EUR 300, AIS100 at EUR 360, LANLink from EUR 300, GPS160 USB at EUR 270 and iKonvert from EUR 240, without stating VAT treatment on the listing.
claims.limitations: Listing page only; the iKonvert and LANLink amounts are 'from' variant prices, not firm single-SKU prices.

claims.claimText: Digital Yacht's AIS category lists three transmit-capable transponder packs at EUR 1,620, EUR 2,046 and EUR 2,100 plus a radar pack at EUR 3,470; none of these is a receive-only receiver.
claims.limitations: Transponders transmit; MAREA AIS is receive-only, so these are substitutes at a different capability and regulatory level.

claims.claimText: Digital Yacht AIS100 PRO is a receive-only AIS receiver with USB and NMEA 0183 outputs that requires a separate VHF/AIS antenna or certified splitter.
claims.observedValue: receive-only; separate antenna or splitter required
claims.limitations: Technical page only; price and availability not displayed on the retrieved page.

claims.claimText: Digital Yacht iKonvert is a bidirectional, galvanically isolated NMEA 2000 to NMEA 0183 converter configured with DIP-switch data modes.
claims.limitations: No local publishing/diagnostics layer, no cloud or multi-device orchestration in the described scope.

claims.claimText: Full Ahead Maritime publishes fleet-size tiers in EUR: Vessel up to 5 ships EUR 1,490/yr, Ocean up to 10 EUR 2,990/yr, Fleet up to 25 EUR 4,990/yr, Squadron up to 50 EUR 7,990/yr, with taxes possibly applicable.
claims.unit: EUR per year by fleet size
claims.limitations: Commercial-shipping technical-management scope; tax treatment depends on location; no hardware, installation or connectivity included.

claims.claimText: UOC prices its platform at EUR 259 per vessel per month, with a two-vessel annual plan at EUR 4,900/year and a 30-day free pilot.
claims.limitations: Commercial fleet operations scope; tax treatment not stated; subject to order form.

claims.claimText: Seafarers.pro lists three per-vessel monthly tiers in EUR: Starter EUR 150, Professional EUR 240 and Enterprise EUR 360, with a 40% first-year launch discount.
claims.limitations: Promotional launch pricing; tax treatment not stated; crew/payroll/QHSE scope, not recreational telematics.

claims.claimText: Raymarine's Spanish store lists Element 7 HV at EUR 659.45, Element 9 HV at EUR 901.45 and Element 12 HV at EUR 1,506.45, each stated to include VAT.
claims.limitations: Display hardware list price only; charts, transducer bundles and installation are separate or vary by SKU.

claims.claimText: Simrad's Spanish store lists NAC-3 basic pack at EUR 3,083.08, NAC-3 processor at EUR 2,136.86, NAC-2 basic pack at EUR 2,100.56 and NAC-2 processor at EUR 1,217.26 including VAT, while marking several listings out of stock and two drive packs discontinued.
claims.limitations: Availability flags conflict with a current-offer reading; no installation, drive unit in all packs, or commissioning included.

claims.claimText: A Spanish retailer lists the complete Raymarine EV-100 Wheel pilot pack at EUR 2,050 including VAT on backorder, with shipping and installation excluded.
claims.limitations: Backorder status; vessel survey, commissioning and sea trial are not included; single retailer.

claims.claimText: Victron SmartShunt 500A IP65 is listed by a Spanish retailer at EUR 90.21 including VAT, with Bluetooth and VE.Direct connectivity.
claims.limitations: Component price only (battery current/voltage/temperature input), no installation; non-marine specialist retailer.

claims.claimText: Victron Cerbo GX MK2 is listed at EUR 240.09 including VAT, with VE.Direct/VE.Can/USB/Ethernet/Wi-Fi/Bluetooth and four tank, four temperature and four digital sensor inputs, plus remote access through the VRM portal.
claims.limitations: Unit price read from a bundle listing; VRM portal availability and terms not priced; sensor inputs need separate sensors.

claims.claimText: B&G Triton2 paddle-wheel instrument pack is listed at EUR 1,149.40 including tax (EUR 949.92 excluding), with a related B&G WS310 wind vane sensor at EUR 489.95 while stock lasts.
claims.limitations: Promotional -10% pack; wind-vane stock caveat; these are instrument displays plus transducers, not a measurement-only module family.

claims.claimText: Secondary editorial evidence reports Siren 3 at USD 299.99 plus USD 225/year, Siren 3 Pro at USD 799.99 plus USD 225/year, ArmIt BilgeMAX One at USD 229.99 kit plus USD 100/year, and Yacht Sentinel YS Pro at EUR 1,590 excluding VAT plus EUR 240/year.
claims.limitations: Affiliate-monetised aggregator; vendor pages inaccessible; Yacht Sentinel current availability unconfirmed; mixed currencies and tax bases.

claims.claimText: Navionics Boating is reported at EUR 49.99 to EUR 149.99 per in-app purchase in Google Play Spain, depending on the item.
claims.limitations: Range, not a single observed price; no manufacturer price list could be retrieved; item scope unclear.

claims.claimText: An editorial review states that Windy Premium, including the Passage Planner weather-routing plugin, costs EUR 19 per year.
claims.limitations: Secondary statement; Windy's own premium page was not retrievable; tax treatment and renewal terms unstated.

claims.claimText: Seven supplier pages that would have carried primary competitor prices were inaccessible or did not render price content on 2026-10-31: Garmin Navionics FAQ, em-trak B100 retailer page, gWind Regata retailer page, Siren Marine storefront, Yacht Sentinel pricing, Savvy Navvy pricing and Windy Premium.
claims.limitations: No price is inferred for these products; the gap is recorded instead.

claims.claimText: No competitor publishes a single installed, commissioned 'bundle' price equivalent to the six MAREA bundles; comparisons must be composed from observed component prices and remain MODEL_DERIVED.
claims.observedValue: DERIVED: no single competitor bundle price observed
claims.limitations: Absence of evidence from this sample; other vendors or installers may quote turnkey prices privately.

claims.claimText: Derived fleet SaaS cost per vessel per month ranges from about EUR 24.83 (Full Ahead Vessel, annual, 5 ships) to EUR 259 (UOC Core monthly), a segment breadth that must not be read as one market price.
claims.limitations: Arithmetic from published annual/monthly list prices; excludes onboarding, hardware, connectivity and tax.

claims.claimText: A START-type alternative composed of Orca Core 2 (EUR 649) plus Orca Plus (EUR 49/year) totals EUR 698 in year one at observed component prices.
claims.limitations: Sum of a secondary-reported hardware price and a tax-unspecified subscription; no installation; Core 2 price is a test-time configurator figure.

claims.claimText: A CRUISE-type Raymarine/Digital Yacht composition (Element 7 HV EUR 659.45 + AIS100 EUR 360 + NavLink2 EUR 300) totals EUR 1,319.45, mixing one VAT-inclusive price with two tax-unspecified prices.
claims.limitations: Mixed tax basis; no charts beyond base, no installation, no gateway configuration labour.

claims.claimText: A SAIL-type composition (EV-100 Wheel EUR 2,050 + Element 7 HV EUR 659.45 + B&G WS310 EUR 489.95 + NavLink2 EUR 300) totals EUR 3,499.40, before installation and without a wind-data display.
claims.limitations: Mixed brands and tax bases; the wind vane alone has no display surface in this composition; no vessel survey or sea trial.

claims.claimText: A COMPLETE-type composition (Element 7 HV EUR 659.45 + EV-100 EUR 2,050 + WS310 EUR 489.95 + AIS100 EUR 360 + Cerbo GX EUR 240.09) totals EUR 3,799.49, before installation, sensors and monitoring subscription.
claims.limitations: Mixed brands/tax bases; no bilge/tank/environment sensors beyond Cerbo inputs; no professional installation, commissioning or warranty on integration.

claims.claimText: Several often-cited 'AIS competitors' are transmit-capable transponders and several 'fleet' comparators are commercial-shipping ERPs, so category match must be justified per observation rather than assumed from industry membership.
claims.observedValue: DERIVED: category mismatches recorded per observation
claims.limitations: Based on the retrieved pages and their stated product scope only.

claims.claimText: Observed competitor prices are heterogeneous in currency, tax treatment and inclusion: EUR VAT-inclusive ES retail/store prices, EUR prices with unstated tax, and USD tax-exclusive subscription lists; no direct cross-currency comparison is valid without a separate model.
claims.limitations: No FX conversion is performed anywhere in this workstream.
